name: XLA_JERS_ATTRS_ASSGNS_
description: This table contains the assignments between journal entry rule set and the accounting attributes at the journal header level.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Financials, or Payroll.

columns.name: AMB_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Context of the accounting methods builder.

columns.name: JERS_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the type of the journal entry rule set. The possible values are: C: owned and defined by the user. S: owned and seeded by Oracle.

columns.name: JERS_CODE
columns.description: Code of the journal entry rule set.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Code of the event class.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the event type.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_ATTRIBUTE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the accounting attribute assigned to the journal entry rule set.

columns.name: SOURCE_ORIGIN_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the subledger source or formula is predefined.

columns.name: SOURCE_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application identifier of the source assigned to the accounting attribute.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the type of the source assigned to the accounting attribute.

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the source assigned to the accounting attribute.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_DEFAULT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicates if the value of the source is defaulted from the accounting attribute assignments at the event class level. The possible values are: Y (Yes) or N (No).

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
